description: Apply this skill whenever you need to design test cases using Domain Testing techniques (Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis). Use when given any input/output specification, business rule, field constraint, API parameter, or functional requirement that involves ranges, sets, formats, or conditions. Triggers include: "design test cases", "write test cases", "identify test data", "EP", "BVA", "equivalence class", "boundary value", "partition", or any request to test a field/function with defined input constraints.
